answer_1.quote: We devise cryptographic techniques [...] to generate constructed languages [...] thus creating languages truly new to LLMs for subsequent experiments. [...] We evaluate an LLM's ability to learn a "new" language using a grammar book [...] by varying the information content of our prompts [...] We rely on match accuracy for quantitative evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: Translated text segments between English and constructed languages

answer_2.quote: We used accuracy as our primary metric [...] An exact match between the LLM’s lowercase candidate translation and the reference translation was scored as 100%; deviations were scored as 0% [...] For Latin-derived conlangs [...] accuracy was computed using bag-of-words matching.
